title.rendered: Information for our Middleton Fun Run 10.10.24

content.rendered:
The Middleton Fun Run is on Thursday, October 10th for PreK-5th grade students. The Fun Run is our MAIN fundraiser for the year. Students will run in the front parking lot again this year, and families are invited to attend and cheer for their students and their classmates. Please stop at the check-in table where you will receive a visitor sticker to wear. More information is coming home today in your student’s Friday Folder. Questions? Check out our FAQ Fun Run Page.

Fun Run Schedule:

PreK/Kindergarten – 8:15 – 8:40

2nd Grade – 8:50 – 9:15

5th Grade – 9:25 – 9:50

4th Grade – 10:00 – 10:25

3rd Grade – 10:35 – 11:00

1st Grade and Skills – 11:05 – 11:30

Our PAC is looking for volunteers to ensure this event is a success. Volunteering for this event is a great opportunity to feel the Middleton School Spirit! We also need volunteers to help pin runner bibs on t-shirts on Tuesday, October 8th. Click HERE for all the opportunities to help.
